Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, 29 May 2026 – The International Cocoa Organization today releases its revised estimates for the 2024/25 cocoa year of world production, grindings, and stocks of cocoa beans, summarized below. The data published in Issue No. 2 – Volume LII – Cocoa Year 2025/26 of the Quarterly Bulletin of Cocoa Statistics, reflects the most recent information available to the Secretariat as at the beginning of May 2026.

Cocoa year

(Oct-Sep)

World grindings 4 810 4 606 4 628 − 182 − 3.8%

End-of-season stocks 1 272 1 347 1 320 + 48 + 3.8%
